subject: [Retro Lab] Open actions — Sprint 4 Retro (Sprint 4)
body:
Sprint 4 Retro
Period: Sprint 4
Team: Chartswap
Archived: October 24, 2026
Open approved actions (4):
• ACT-0001 — Define a release readiness checklist with automated pre-deploy gates
  Teams: Dev Team, QA Team, Ops Team | Target: 2026-10-24
  The team raised release reliability themes (FB-0001, FB-0002). A shared go/no-go checklist and automated pipeline gates should catch blockers before promote.
• ACT-0002 — Agree an urgent PR first-response SLA and escalation path
  Teams: Dev Team, Management Team | Target: 2026-10-24
  Slow turnaround on urgent reviews was raised (FB-0003, FB-0005). Set a measurable first-response target and escalation when reviewers are unavailable.
• ACT-0003 — Pilot two-reviewer policy exceptions for labeled hotfix PRs
  Teams: Dev Team, Management Team | Target: 2026-10-24
  Urgent review delays and two-reviewer policy appeared together (FB-0003, FB-0005). Pilot hotfix-labeled exceptions with mandatory post-merge review.
• ACT-0004 — Timebox planning sessions and require async pre-reads plus decision logs
  Teams: Product Team, Management Team | Target: 2026-10-24
  Long planning and async status ideas (FB-0004, FB-0006). Cap live planning and distribute pre-reads before the session.
Themes: Release reliability and incident response: The team reported dependable production releases with no rollbacks and coordinated quickly when a customer escalation arrived. Code review turnaround: Review turnaround remains a bottleneck for urgent fixes; the team wants consistent two-reviewer practice from earlier retros. Sprint planning efficiency: Planning sessions exceed ninety minutes; the team proposed time-boxing and async status notes.
